title: Learning Under Treatment-Induced Label Indeterminacy with Expert Annotations of Counterfactual Outcomes: A Case Study in Neurological Prognostication
abstract: arXiv:2608.12477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical prediction models are often developed as if the outcome of interest were cleanly observed for every patient. This assumption fails when treatment decisions make the clinically relevant outcome permanently unobservable. As a case study of this problem, we consider post-cardiac-arrest neurological prognostication using a cohort of 2,497 patients, including 1,429 patients whose outcomes were rendered indeterminate by treatment decisions. These patients with indeterminate outcomes were reviewed by independent clinical experts, who provided their guesses of counterfactual outcomes about what would have happened to the patients. We refer to these patients as uncertain cases. We also have patients for whom we observe their clinically relevant outcomes; we refer to these patients as certain cases. translated_title: 治疗诱导的标签不确定性下利用反事实结局专家注释的学习：神经预后评估案例研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12477v1 公告类型：新 摘要：临床预测模型通常是在假设每位患者的结局都能被清晰观察的前提下开发的。然而，当治疗决策使得临床相关结局永久不可观测时，这一假设便失效了。作为该问题的一个案例研究，我们考虑了心脏骤停后的神经预后评估，使用了一个包含2,497名患者的队列，其中1,429名患者的结局因治疗决策而变得不确定。这些结局不确定的患者由独立的临床专家进行审查，专家们提供了关于患者可能发生情况的推测性反事实结局。我们将这些患者称为不确定病例。我们还有一部分患者，其临床相关结局是可观测的，我们称这些患者为确定病例。我们提出了一种评估预测模型的框架，该框架明确地将评估分为确定和不确定病例两部分。在此，我们...
tldr: 本研究提出一个评估框架，针对治疗导致结局不可观测的临床预测模型，将评估明确分为确定和不确定病例，并以心脏骤停后神经预后为案例验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an evaluation framework for clinical prediction models under treatment-induced outcome unobservability, explicitly separating assessment into certain and uncertain cases, validated in post-cardiac-arrest neurological prognostication.
